name: Welcome to Africa
source:
Steven can spend fifteen years chasing a cancer treatment and still be the person who has to stay behind when the expedition finally leaves. BNW will pay for the search for Aniphius, but only if he keeps working in New York. Nate goes in his place with Charlotte and a guide named Kay.

That arrangement sounds manageable while everyone is still packing. Then the messages start arriving.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/WelcometoAfrica/posts/welcome-to-1-is-174984403]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
哪怕史蒂文花上整整十五年追寻治愈癌症的疗法，等到科考队终于启程的那一刻，被迫留在原地的依然是他。BNW愿意出资支持寻找“阿尼菲乌斯”的行动，但前提是他必须继续留在纽约工作。于是，内特代替他踏上旅途，随行的还有夏洛特与名叫凯的向导。

趁着众人还在收拾行装时，这样的安排听起来倒也算稳妥。直到一条条消息开始陆续传来。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/WelcometoAfrica/posts/welcome-to-1-is-174984403]Patreon[/url]]
